portInfo.description: PACI operates Port of George Town (19°18′N 81°23′W) with a Cruise Operations manager and published cruise-ship passenger/tender fees. Harbour cargo berths max out at 122 m LOA / 5.5 m draught, so typical cruise ships anchor and run tenders on VHF channel 10. Pre-arrival notification 24 hours ahead supports immigration pre-clearance so guests can start disembarking on arrival when granted. Weather can halt berthing with SW–NW onshore winds; daylight berthing only below 17 kt sustained for alongside moves.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: George Town harbour streets / shopping — ~90 min.
Seven Mile Beach — transfer; fare table on PACI.
Stingray / island tours — line or licensed operators; not verified individually here.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Tender cancellations happen in rough weather — have a ship-day backup.
